note_en: 任何 ("any") usually pairs with a negative to mean "no one / nothing at all": 不允许任何人质疑他的决定 "he did not allow anyone to question his decisions." English can also say "he allowed no one," but Chinese has no word like "no one" here; it must say 不 + verb + 任何人. In positive sentences 任何 normally needs 都 after it: 任何人都可以 "anyone can."
